column1: # The skills that the LinkedIn cover shows for a pin (just cover), in their order, when the owner
# chose them; a pin with no skills shows its language and GitHub topics. skills: separated by ", ".
# marks: what else the owner put on the box, separated by ", ": br (Brazil's flag), doi (the
# DOI of the work of the same name in site/data/works.tsv), lock (a padlock beside the name: the
# repository is private, and the cover shows it all the same), org (the box stands for the
# organisation that owns the repository, with its counts). Or empty.

column4: the owner, 21 October 2026 (the marks: 22 October 2026; org: 28 October 2026)
